Package hadur2.core.melee

Class MeleeProfileCodec

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.melee.MeleeProfileCodec
public final class MeleeProfileCodec extends Object
The melee profile block's file format (MMEM-1): small, hand-written, versioned and checksummed like the 1v1 profile's, and written to its own file beside it. 
 'H' 'M'           magic
 u8                version (1)
 i32               payload length
 payload           key (u8 length, UTF-16 code units), i32 rounds, i64 lastFought,
                   u8 count, then that many f32 counts (see encode(hadur2.core.melee.MeleeProfile))
 i32               CRC-32 of everything before it

decode(byte[]) either returns a block whose every count is finite and not negative, or throws MeleeProfileFormatException; no input, however damaged, makes it throw anything else. Only version 1 is read: a block from any other version is rejected like a damaged one, so the opponent is met as a stranger rather than misread. Encoding is canonical: decoding a block and encoding it again gives the same bytes.
